subject: QBR prep: one-pager assembly + forecast consolidation requests
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: one-pager assembly + forecast consolidation requests

Team —

Quick leadership ask for our QBR on 10/15: I want a tight set of account one-pagers (1 slide / 1 paragraph) for the top 12 deals by runway. Objective is two things: (1) a canonical ask-ready summary for execs and (2) a consolidated forecast table that leadership can sign off on.

Deliverables (please) by end of day Thursday 10/8: 
- Single-slide one-pager using the attached template for each assigned account (owner, ARR, next milestone, risks, mitigation, ask) — fill only the fields we can justify.
- Updated forecast line in the shared spreadsheet for each account you own (tab: Q4-Forecast).

Assignments:
- Karthik: Adept Analytics, Nova Health, and Mosaic Retail
- Laura: Meridian Cloud, FalconOps
- Tessa: Orion Labs, NimbusData
- Marcus: TerraSolve, Apollo Biotech

Notes: prioritize accuracy over optimism. If you need the customer to confirm numbers, send the short confirmation ask (template in the drive) and flag items that are pending. Security/compliance notes for Adept: they asked for audit log retention details — include the summary line under "risks".

I attached a fresh one-pager template and the forecast workbook. Reach out if any blockers.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Field Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Hannah —

Acknowledged. I started the Adept one-pager and updated the shared sheet with my initial numbers. A couple of caveats:
- Adept supplied a revised uplift for Q4 but procurement wants a PO cadence confirmed before we mark it as committed. I've set it as "best case" in the sheet and left a comment for procurement confirmation.
- For Adept's security ask: SOC2 evidence is available; I'll add a short blurb on retention (30 days default, optional 90-day archive with dedicated contract clause).

I'm going to ping Elaine to confirm the PO date and get the procurement contact looped. Attaching my draft one-pager (stub) and the forecast tab.

Karthik

Hi Karthik / Hannah —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick confirmations from our side: 
- We expect to issue the PO for the initial committed capacity by 10/22; finance has approved the Q4 uplift pending a final statement of work. 
- Per the security question: we need a one-paragraph summary about audit log retention and access controls for our compliance team. 30 days sounds fine for default logs; would like an optional higher-retention add-on.
- Updated Q4 ARR estimate: $1.2M (was $950k previously) — I’ll attach the internal spreadsheet to this thread.

I can make time Friday morning (our timezone) for a 20-minute sync if you want to run through the one-pager items live.
